summary: Discharge application in corruption case; standard: prima facie case from charge-sheet material; court not to evaluate defence at discharge stage; IO and sanctioning authority's failure to consider explanations: question of fact for trial; compliance with service rules not conclusive of legitimacy; disproportionate assets exceeding 40% of known income; High Court erroneously re-evaluated evidence; impugned discharge set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: State of Tamil Nadu vs. N. Suresh Rajan And Others (2014) 11 SCC 709
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order allowing revision set aside; discharge quashed; trial court's order reinstated; respondent to face trial.
